description: 📋 React Hooks for form state management and validation (Web + React Native)

latest_release.name: Version 7.92.0
latest_release.body:
## 🐞 Fixes

- Fix `useFormState` and `Controller` unnecessarily cloning form state during mount and unmount (#13945)
- Fix `setValues` not updating dirty state for unregistered fields (#13946)
- Fix form state values becoming inconsistent (#13948)
- Fix `setValue` not selecting checkbox options with empty string values (#13950)
- Fix stale asynchronous form-level validation results (#13951, #13954)
- Fix `useFieldArray` applying `reValidateMode: 'onSubmit'` before submission (#13952)
- Fix default values not being applied correctly to selects with disabled optgroups (#13953)
- Fix `useController` reading stale `shouldUnregister` options (#13956, #13996)
- Fix focusing disabled radio and checkbox inputs (#13960, #13968, #13977)
- Fix TypeScript type regression (#13963)
- Fix field array notifications using stale values (#13965)
- Fix rejected submission callbacks with falsy rejection reasons (#13967)
- Fix `useWatch` missing `reset()` updates on mount in React Native (#13974)
- Fix `trigger` losing nested field array root errors (#13975)
- Fix `unregister` retaining descendant registrations when removing a parent (#13976)
- Fix `trigger` not marking nested fields as touched when `shouldTouch` targets a parent (#13978)
- Fix `useWatch` compute cache not synchronizing when `compute` is removed (#13987)
- Fix `setValues` ignoring options when values remain unchanged (#13989)
- Fix `handleSubmit` incorrectly updating form state after `reset()` during asynchronous callbacks (#13991)
- Fix `useFieldArray` retaining validation rules after the rules prop is removed (#13992)
- Fix `reset` not updating `isValid` after cancelling pending validation (#13994)
- Fix TypeScript nested array paths not preserving `undefined` (#13995)
- Fix `<Form />` not respecting `encType` when constructing request bodies (#13997)
- Fix `handleSubmit` not supporting nullish and primitive transformed values with disabled fields (#13999, #14011)
- Fix `useController` dirty tracking with controller-level `defaultValue` (#14001)
- Fix multi-select changes including disabled options (#14002)
- Fix `register` overwriting untouched range and color input defaults (#14007)
- Fix stale schema resolver errors after field array operations (#14008)
- Fix `unset` failing on primitive values (#14014)
- Fix form-level validation errors appearing before submission during `isValid` checks (#14015)
- Fix stale field errors when form-level validation returns a message (#14016)
- Fix repeated `reset()` calls and error focusing with `keepFieldsRef` and memoized inputs (#14023)

## ⚡ Performance Improvements

- Avoid unnecessary form state cloning in `useFormState` and `Controller` (#13945)

## 🧹 Refactors

- Skip non-dirty array holes when collecting dirty field names (#13979)
- Avoid mutating field metadata when building resolver options (#13984)

## 🧪 Tests

- Expand regression coverage for `reset`, `useController`, `useFieldArray`, validation, dirty state and form submissions
- Add regression coverage for disabled radio and checkbox inputs, React Native reset handling, and primitive transformed values

## 📦 Dependencies

- Bump `fast-uri` from 3.1.8 to 3.1.9 (#13949)
- Bump `follow-redirects` from 1.16.1 to 1.16.2 (#13985)
- Bump `vite` from 6.4.4 to 6.4.5 (#13983)
- Bump `joi` from 18.2.9 to 18.3.1 (#13986)

## ❤️ Thank You

Thanks to @charan-rathore, @clean99, @KooYS, @dfedoryshchev, @maxymlyskov, @aumilkyeong, @hamarshehmhmd, @zigzagdev, @wozhenbang2004, @Aminark, @zendesk-robryan, @MomenSherif, @Shellghostt, @SatyamGangani, @yxshee, @timsnadden and @bluebill1049 for their contributions! 🎉

Special thanks to the **Pennylane team** for their incredible support! ❤️
